svg.title: vn_weather_fabric architecture
svg.desc: Batch pipeline on Microsoft Fabric with a simulated on-premises migration and a GitHub Actions CI flow.

text.tspan: vn_weather_fabric | Batch weather pipeline with an on-premises migration, on Microsoft Fabric
Silver and Gold use the same notebooks
Migration writes only ts before it,
Backfill only from it; a row on the
Semantic model, Direct Lake on OneLake
CI/CD (one workspace, one main branch; no dev or test environment)
Arrows show data flow (solid) and code reuse (dashed). Fabric item icons are drawn by hand, not the official set.
